text:
olivia: Pushed a fresh iteration of the stacktrace "minimap" prototype to Figma. It's pinned in the top-right of the trace pane, shows condensed frames, and supports click-to-jump + drag-to-scrub. Also added a temporary "Download" item in the kebab. Can folks review for copy, accessibility, and dev tradeoffs?
marta: Nice! One UX question: when you click the minimap, do we assume instant navigation or animate? If instant, we should provide a quick undo.
cheng: a11y quick pass: minimap must be reachable by keyboard (tab/arrow to move the thumb), expose a textual label like "Trace minimap, frames 1-234, viewport frames 45-62" to SRs, and ensure the thumb contrast meets 3:1. Right now thumb is low contrast.
trevor: Regarding animation, keep it subtle (<150ms) and honor prefers-reduced-motion. For narrow viewports, it'd collapse to a micro-scrubber at the bottom of the pane.
samir: Copy in the kebab currently says "Export trace" and "Copy permalink". I think we should avoid vague verbs. Propose: "Download trace JSON" and "Copy trace link". Make the file format explicit in the download string.
olivia: Agree with the copy suggestion. Also proposing we surface correlation ids at top-level in the downloaded JSON for easier downstream ingestion (keep the existing meta.correlation_id for backward compat). Thoughts?
cheng: top-level correlation_id is helpful for automation. Do both and document the change. Also, telemetry: track minimap_open, minimap_jump (include frame_index), trace_download, trace_link_copy.
marta: tiny keyboard idea: when the trace panel is focused, pressing "k" or "," could toggle the minimap focus and then arrow keys move the thumb. Need to check conflicts with other shortcuts.
a11ybot: auto-scan result: thumb fill #a6d1ff on white yields contrast 2.6:1. Suggest #6fbfff or add 2px outline of #005fbf for focus. Also advise adding aria-live announcements for download/copy flows.
cheng: will update spec: thumb color -> #6fbfff; add 2px focus ring (brand-strong) and include a hidden SR text element that reads current viewport when users move the thumb.
trevor: Regarding the download flow: if we client-side generate a blob, announce "Trace download started" then "Download ready" via aria-live. For copy, announce "Trace link copied" and also show a short toast.
samir: Note on wording: toast for copy should be brief: "Trace link copied". For SR-only aria-label include the full URL. For download toast: "Trace JSON queued" maybe confusing; use "Download started".
olivia: Figma updated with new copy & updated minimap states: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/minimap-v2. Prototype link: https://redwood-internal/prototypes/minimap-v2.
marta: Dev constraints: minimap should not block main thread. Implement as a lightweight canvas/svg and debounce scrubbing events to avoid spamming kernel. Also consider virtualization for very long traces.
cheng: accessibility checklist I'll run: keyboard focus order, aria-labels, aria-live regions, contrast, reduced-motion. I'll report back tomorrow.
trevor: small prod note: add an analytics flag for rollout so we can A/B the minimap and measure click-to-jump conversion and any negative regressions in navigation.
samir: also add context to events: trace_id, origin_panel, clicked_frame_index, user_tier.
olivia: final copy decisions: Kebab -> ["Download trace JSON", "Copy trace link", "Open in timeline"]. Toast copy -> copy: "Trace link copied", download: "Download started" with an inline "Close" button.
a11ybot: suggestion: for the mini-scrubber on mobile use larger touch target (min 44px) and ensure tapping expands to full minimap for better precision.
marta: implementing mobile scrubber as a toggle to expand into full modal for precision.
cheng: remember to include prefers-reduced-motion in CSS and respect OS settings when animating viewport jumps.
trevor: let's keep jump animation <150ms and provide an instant-jump fallback when user holds Shift (power user).
olivia: creating a short PR checklist: 1) update copy in UI & Figma, 2) ensure minimap accessible + focusable, 3) implement telemetry events, 4) add undo toast for jumps, 5) mobile scrubber behavior. I'll post PR link when ready.
marta: I'll prototype a performant svg version and share demo.
cheng: running color and screenreader tests tomorrow; will post results.
samir: adding telemetry schema to the infra board.
olivia: thanks everyone! Closing this thread once PR lands.
